_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 54: 21-26 March 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of a darkness trying to settle in over their area with liberalness, says he will not have that here, that they will be a Bible believing people who rise up and proclaim that Jesus Christ is coming over their area, and that they need revival even in Tulsa.
mentions.quote: darkness that's trying to settle in over here with liberalness
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a reading of his own city's spiritual condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says revival starts with them and that they stand as the barrier so the devil cannot have this nation, saying no to Satan, and comes against even the things being shown him.
mentions.quote: revival starts with us. the devil cannot have this nation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and note he comes against the things he was just shown, which is vision-is-a-prayer-target stated in the same breath as the sight.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is appointed unto man and unto woman once to die and after that the judgment, and addresses those who were once radical for Jesus but grew weary in well doing over the course of time.
mentions.quote: It's appointed unto man once to die. And after that, the judgment
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they have it ready and tells them to play some of the things the Lord showed them about the moon, noting this was on December the 2nd and that he told them of it last year.
mentions.quote: play some of the things the Lord has showed us about the moon
mentions.falsify_match: A lunar base announcement, with the 2 December telling in this corpus to check it against.
mentions.falsify_miss: The recording does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must have a relationship with God by themselves and must find him because they are running out of time, that it is time to stop playing church, that Jesus Christ is coming and is standing at the door, and that he has seen vision after vision of him.
mentions.quote: You're running out of time. It's time to stop playing church
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: imminence with no date, and the visions are offered as the evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he said it will be so loud soon that it will break the glass out of houses and cars because it will be such a sonic boom coming so fast, and that it will break and shake the buildings.
mentions.quote: it will break the glass out of your houses and your cars
mentions.falsify_match: Sonic booms causing property damage, which would be reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. Soon carries no date but the effect described is concrete and would be visible.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warned them this is coming and then warned that a lot of them will call it an Ichabod when they ask what is going on with everything, but that the Lord said it is not an Ichabod even though they consider bad things happening to be one.
mentions.quote: a lot of you will call it an Ichabod
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a pre-emptive answer to the obvious reading: hard events are not the glory departing.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must pray for Taiwan because China will take them within three days of the day they start, that it is not a fight but a surrender of the island, and that it will be about manipulating the chips and medicine.
mentions.quote: China will take them within 3 days. They surrender the island
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan falling in about three days without significant fighting.
mentions.falsify_miss: No invasion, or a contested one. Three days again, where the original claim said two, and the chips and medicine motive is new.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said that as of the 1st of April the birthing pains will double from here on out and be even more, that as labour pains upon a woman so will it be, and that birthing pains do not decrease but increase before the coming.
mentions.quote: as of the 1st of April, the birthing pains will double from here on out
mentions.falsify_match: A visibly faster tempo of events after 1 April.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Birthing pains that by definition only increase cannot decrease, so the claim is self-sealing and he says so.

mentions.claim_text: He says to help bring in this precious fruit and not to look at yourself as lowly for being the person who passes out the tracts or the offering bucket, thanks God for them, and says it is all hands on deck.
mentions.quote: don't look at yourself as lowly. it's all hands on deck
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says it would look in the days ahead like he is confused, even more so, and that going through Easter it will look confused, and lifts him up so that he takes no counsel even from the ones he thinks he can trust.
mentions.quote: It would look in the days ahead like he's confused
mentions.falsify_match: A period of visible presidential confusion around Easter.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Looks confused is a reading of appearances rather than a stated event, so any coverage can satisfy it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees people around him influenced with Ivy League education, that these are what they call brilliant minds but they are led by the devil, and that he hears Ivy League education like people from Harvard.
mentions.quote: brilliant minds, but they're led by the devil. I hear Ivy League education
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a judgment about unnamed advisers' spiritual condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says for prayer they will go over the things the Lord showed them in the last video from Friday night, that they have a lot to share on it, and that he will be quick so they can pray longer over the nation.
mentions.quote: we're going to go over the things the Lord showed us this last video
mentions.falsify_match: The prior video is in this corpus, so the review of it can be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He describes England, Italy, Germany and others saying they have made their bed and now let them lie in it, and says he saw them talking to the Democratic Party to devise a plan of making Trump look foolish concerning the midterms.
mentions.quote: talking to the Democratic Party to devise a plan of making Trump look foolish
mentions.falsify_match: Documented coordination between European governments and an American party.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. This is an unobservable meeting by construction.

mentions.claim_text: He says they see articles today that someone found, works out who found them, and shows one headlined that the CIA is accused of poisoning the sky, mentioning toxins.
mentions.quote: CIA accused of poisoning the sky
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: an article shown on screen, offered as confirmation of the weather warfare material.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be all hands on deck because the harvest is plentiful and the labourers are few, and that as they were praying tonight they interceded for a major move of God, a major harvest of souls, and for this youth building.
mentions.quote: For the harvest is plentiful, and the laborers are few
mentions.falsify_match: A youth building completed and a reported harvest.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told I am going to do something major, says that when you see in part and hear in part you think it will be next month or two or three months, but that now is the year of 1 Corinthians 5:5, getting the church ready for the bride.
mentions.quote: you think it's going to be that next month, two months, three months
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is an explanation for why dated words do not land when expected: the seeing is partial, so the timing slips.

mentions.claim_text: They recall what he saw in the last video, that he saw the undercurrent agenda 2030 and then a noose around a human, and he confirms he saw a noose, said to be about control.
mentions.quote: you saw a noose around human. trying to control
mentions.falsify_match: See the agenda claim it belongs to.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the White House and is praying over it and over the Easter egg hunts with the children, praying across the nation, and that it is not just here because he sees Africa highlighted and attacks on the Muslim side.
mentions.quote: praying over Easter egg hunts with these kids. I see Africa highlighted
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at an Easter gathering in America or an attack in Africa.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. Attacks on Christians in parts of Africa are frequent enough that the second half is close to unmissable.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man with a beard lying with his eyes closed who suddenly hears a loud boom and commotion and opens his eyes, and says the Lord said I am waking up my bride, it is time.
mentions.quote: I'm waking up my bride. It's time
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, though the loud boom links it to the sonic boom material.

mentions.claim_text: He says he cannot put him in a box and say this is what you are doing, that he wonders what he is doing and tries to figure it out in his mind, because he is saying acceleration by double on Passover which is April 1st.
mentions.quote: he's saying acceleration by double on Passover, which is April 1st
mentions.falsify_match: See the Passover acceleration claim.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth noting he says he does not understand what he has been given, while repeating the date.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is probably going to be in May, the end of May, and they settle on May 24th, Pentecost Sunday, and he says he is glad he showed up tonight before offering the opportunity to accept Christ.
mentions.quote: May 24th. Pentecost Sunday
mentions.falsify_match: An event held on Pentecost Sunday, which is a fixed calendar date.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not happen. Read off the church calendar rather than seen.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray for these oil areas because it is very serious, that he saw President Trump opening up new pipelines as he is talking about in California, that he told them he would open new pipelines throughout America, and mentions Nord Stream.
mentions.quote: I told you he would open up new pipelines throughout America
mentions.falsify_match: New pipeline approvals, and a prior telling in this corpus saying so.
mentions.falsify_miss: No approvals, or no prior telling.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them there would be an acceleration of this right before Jesus comes, and that the Lord said it when he went to heaven with him and was on the edge of heaven in 2014 on July the 6th.
mentions.quote: I was on the edge of heaven in 2014 July the 6th
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private experience twelve years ago, outside this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what that is, says it will be twelve years in July since Jesus visited him, that here in America it is becoming a major deal, and points to everybody worshipping this Friday again right after Ramadan.
mentions.quote: 12 years in July when Jesus visited me
mentions.falsify_match: Measurable growth in Muslim observance in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such growth. He is reading a public gathering as the evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was in the middle of the night and the Lord said this will be worse than October the 7th and said to pray, because he saw women and children and families being destroyed and it was not just a little bit but a lot of people.
mentions.quote: I saw women and children and families being destroyed
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack with mass civilian casualties exceeding 7 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Sixth telling since November, now with the casualty description filled in and still no date.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip in which someone says it is a disaster and the worst it has ever been and is asked what they are hearing, and comments on a reporter wanting a hard question.
mentions.quote: It's the worst it's ever been
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a played press clip.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard what was said right then, that the Lord said to tell him to give praise for everything he has done for him this week, and gives thanks as they enter the last week of March.
mentions.quote: Tell him to give me praise for everything I've done for him this week
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction to a listener, delivered live.
